title: Sightseeing Tour
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 4 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 400; N-1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq U_i < V_i \leq N; 1 \leq T_i \leq 10^9; 1 \leq Q \leq 3000; 1 \leq K_i \leq 5; 1 \leq B_{i,1} < B_{i,2} < \cdots < B_{i,K_i} \leq M; All input values are integers.; It is possible to travel between any two islands using some bridges.
